Goal GOAL_RESILIENT_EXECUTION (Recover from transient execution failures without unbounded work)
Feature FEAT_PROVIDER_RETRY (Provider retry)
Requirement REQ_PROVIDER_RETRY (Retry only temporary provider failures): Temporary provider failures shall be eligible for retry, while permanent failures shall not be retried as if they were transient.
Technical requirement TREQ_PROVIDER_RETRY_BOUNDS (Same-route provider retry is bounded): For one resolved provider route, provider execution shall perform no more than the configured retry maximum-attempt count before surfacing the final failure to routing.
